en: Tasks using a configured assistant now receive its live mother-package rules and memory navigation, plus the current local memory registry when available. Skills and memory are read as needed; connector authorization remains separate.
Routine draft saving is asynchronous and older writes cannot overwrite newer edits or closing snapshots. Closing and update preparation still flush drafts before proceeding.
Input no longer reparses unchanged Markdown previews or execution logs. Markdown files over 128 KiB display their complete content as plain text and remain editable to avoid costly formatting.
zh: 已配置助手的任务现在明确接入母包现役全局规则、记忆导航及可用的本机记忆索引；技能和记忆按需读取，连接器授权仍独立。
普通草稿保存改为异步，旧写入不会覆盖新输入或关闭时的草稿；关闭及更新准备仍先完成草稿保存。
输入时不再反复解析未变化的 Markdown 预览和执行记录；超过 128 KiB 的 Markdown 以完整纯文本预览，保留编辑功能，避免大量格式解析。
